title: Enterprise AI Evaluation CI/CD Pipeline & LLM-as-a-Judge Bias Calibration Selection Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Uncalibrated 1-10 Likert LLM Judge on All 2,000 Cases Every PR
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 31% verbosity/position bias (clustering at 7-8/10), 44m CI wait & $165K/mo TCO

tiers.name: Tier 2: Classical Lexical Overlap Only (BLEU / ROUGE-L / Exact String)
tiers.verdict: 42.5% false alarms on valid paraphrased answers; developers disable the CI gate

tiers.name: Tier 3: Manual Spreadsheet 'Vibe Check' of 20 Samples Before Release
tiers.verdict: 3-hour manual bottleneck & misses 38% of edge-case production regressions

tiers.name: Tier 4: 80% Code/NLI Asserts + Binary Yes/No Rubric + Position-Swap + 1.5m Stratified PR Gate
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 96.8% human alignment (Kappa=0.91), 1.5m PR gate, 3.2% bias & -88.5% TCO
